scope: why CL_Connect only ran its front half

sub_state_table.source: jmp [eax*4+0x5C0F2C] at 0x5C0673 where eax comes from call 0x7F4F10([cl+0x28])
sub_state_table.reading: sub-states 0 and 3 go to 0x5C067A (which calls 0x5BE700 and bails if it returns 0), sub-state 1 returns immediately, sub-state 2 goes to 0x5C0693

logic: mov eax,[0x7887040]; call [0xCA8168](eax,0); test eax,eax; jne return0
mov eax,[0x7886E64]; test eax,eax; je return0
check_function.meaning: it validates two handles ([0x7887040] and [0x7886E64]) through an indirect function; if either is missing or the call reports failure it returns 0

consequence: CL_Connect calls 0x5BE700 right after the sub-state dispatch (0x5C067A). A 0 return jumps to 0x5C0F1B, the function exit -- which explains why only cl+0x30/0x34 were touched and clc.state was never written.
